question: Brown adipose tissue (BAT) activation through B-adrenergic signalling pathway is associated with expression of thermogenic genes and the process of thermogenesis. Glycogen synthase kinase-3 (GSK3) acts as a regulator of B-adrenergic signalling in brown adipocytes. ISO is also a chemical stimulator of BAT activation; its effect on GSK3 is shown by the Western blot below (p-GSK3 is phosphorylated form of GSK3). SB216763 is an inhibitor of GSK3.
